Components

Explore the complete set of UI components

Karibase provides a comprehensive set of pre-built components that you can use to build your dashboards and admin panels. Each component is highly customizable and follows best practices for accessibility and performance.

Buttons

Interactive buttons with multiple styles and states

Cards

Container components for content organization

Forms

Input fields and form controls

Tables

Data tables with sorting and pagination

Navigation

Navigation components for menus and breadcrumbs

Modals

Dialog boxes for user interactions

Alerts

Feedback messages for user notifications

Charts

Data visualization components and progress indicators

Badges

Small labels and status indicators

Avatars

User profile images and initials

Dropdowns

Toggleable content overlays

Tooltips

Hoverable information overlays

Floating Bots

20 chatbot examples from advanced to simple

Component Structure

All Karibase components follow a consistent naming convention using the kb- prefix. This prevents conflicts with other CSS frameworks and makes it easy to identify Karibase components in your code.

html
<!-- Component structure example -->
<div class="kb-card">
  <div class="kb-card-header">
    <h3 class="kb-card-title">Title</h3>
  </div>
  <div class="kb-card-body">
    Content goes here
  </div>
  <div class="kb-card-footer">
    <button class="kb-btn kb-btn-primary">Action</button>
  </div>
</div>

Customization

Components can be customized using CSS variables or by overriding specific classes. See the Theming section for more details on customization options.

Need more components?

Karibase is continuously evolving. Check back often for new components and features.
